name: ecommerce-customer-service-workspace-api
description: HTTP adapter over the customer service workspace module: the queue an agent works, the conversation a customer resumes with the claim they were issued, the transcript, the notes, the assembled timeline and the service quality measured about all of it.
features: Every route carries a rate limit, including the two the host left open: the transcript and the customer's own record are throttled by the surface, because the domain has no request to count
There are two actor families and one mechanical split: an agent arrives with a credential and an ability, a participant arrives with the claim the module issued, and no route serves both
The merchant is never accepted from a path, a query string or a body: an agent's comes from the credential, a participant's from a request attribute the host's channel middleware resolved
The claim is returned once, in the body of the response that opened the conversation, and no other response ever carries it
The claim travels in a header and never in a path or a query string, so it does not land in an access log or a Referer
There is no idempotency key on opening a conversation: serving a retry would mean serving a one-time secret twice
All nine refusal reasons the domain can return are classified, asserted exhaustive by test, so a tenth cannot arrive as a 500
A refused action request answers 4xx or 5xx with the persisted request beside the error, because the workspace asked and the record exists whatever the owning module said
A timeline with a source nobody bound answers 200 naming that source in `skipped`, never an entry list that looks complete
Queue position null means not queued and is never rendered as zero or as first
The three service figures are null when the thing has not happened, and null is never rendered as zero: an unanswered conversation is not instant service
A score out of range is the domain's refusal and not the surface's validation rule, so the range lives in one place
Another merchant's reference, one that does not exist and a claim that does not match are one 404 with one body
An agent assigns themselves and the agent reference comes from the credential: there is no route that names another agent
The queue listing carries no name and no email, because an agent who has not opened a conversation has no reason to read them
OpenAPI 3.1 kept in parity with the router in both directions, including the ability each operation enforces and the throttle every one of them carries
